progress.api: mcp.ClientOptions.ProgressNotificationHandler on the client passed as mcptoolset.Config.Client; mcpTool.Run calls CallTool with no progress token

logging.api: mcp.ClientOptions.LoggingMessageHandler on the client passed as mcptoolset.Config.Client

completion.unsupported: mcptoolset.Toolset exposes only Tools(); the *mcp.ClientSession it opens stays inside its connectionRefresher, so the caller has no session to call Complete on

cancellation.mechanism: cancelling the context.Context passed to Runner.Run; mcpTool.Run hands it to ClientSession.CallTool
cancellation.outcome: abandoned: cancelled the context passed to Runner.Run; the tool call ended with failed to call MCP tool "cancellable_wait" with err: context canceled

caching.api: mcptoolset Toolset.Tools (calls ListTools on every call; no cache option)
